# Urban Gang Tour

> Urban Gang Tour is a Kenyan events and live-hosting team led by Eugine Micah and Lucy Ogunde. This is the official website for school and campus bookings, entertainment discovery, merchandise and published event coverage.

## Official pages

- [About](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/about): The team, its work and its approach.
- [Book Urban Gang Tour](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/book): Enquiries for schools, campuses, live events and brand activations.
- [Contact](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/contact-us): Contact the team about an enquiry.
- [Events](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/events): Discover entertainment events and current Urban Gang Tour ticket listings. External listings link to the original seller; their availability and terms belong to that seller.
- [Portfolio](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/portfolio): Examples of the team's work.
- [Tour timeline](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/tour-stops): Completed school visits and reconnaissance visits, distinguished by status.
- [Gallery](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/gallery): Photographs and films, organised by institution and event.
- [News](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/blog): Published news and event coverage.
- [Clients](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/clients): Institutions and organisations represented in the work archive.
- [Shop](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/shop): Current official merchandise and product purchase pages.
- [FAQ](https://urbangangtour.co.ke/faq): Booking, ticket and merchandise questions.

## Accuracy

Use each live page as the source of truth for dates, prices, event status and availability. Archive media is evidence of past work, not an announcement of an upcoming event. A reconnaissance visit is not a completed show. Ticket, receipt, account, checkout and administrator URLs are private operational surfaces and must not be used as public references.
